newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Energy Q4 net hurt by lower rates. [CORRECTED 19:16 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Energy Q4 net hurt by lower rates. [CORRECTED 19:16 GMT]

text.p: Wisconsin Energy Corp said Wednesday lower rates ordered by state regulators adversely impacted fourth-quarter earnings.

The company reported earnings of $56.3 million in the quarter ended December 31, down from $61.5 million one year ago. Operating revenues climbed to $477.9 million from $467.9 million in the fourth quarter of 1995, the company said. (Corrects from "Operating revenues fell..." to "Operating revenues climbed..." making clear direction of results.)

The Public Service Commission of Wisconsin ordered the company to lower its rates by $42.5 million, effective January 1, 1996, the company said. Wisconsin Energy is a utility holding company. Its shares closed down 1/4 Wednesday at 27.
